parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the watermark image, in pixels. Valid values: 100 to 5000.

parameters.name: Opacity
parameters.description: The opacity of the watermark image. Valid values: 1 to 255. A larger value indicates lower transparency.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: The scaling ratio of the watermark image.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the watermark image, in pixels. Valid values: 100 to 5000.

parameters.name: WmInfoBytesB64
parameters.description: The watermark information in Base64-encoded string format. The length is 1 to 300 characters. If this parameter is set, the WmInfoUint parameter cannot be set.

parameters.name: WmInfoSize
parameters.description: The bit width of the watermark information capacity. Default value: 32. This parameter must be consistent between embedding and extraction. For example, if the SDK used for embedding is 40-bit, set this parameter to 40 during extraction as well.

parameters.name: WmInfoUint
parameters.description:
The watermark information in decimal number format. If this parameter is set, WmInfoBytesB64 cannot be set.

The valid range depends on the WmInfoSize parameter:

- If WmInfoSize is **32**, the valid range is 1 to 4294967295.

- If WmInfoSize is **40**, the valid range is 1 to 1099511627775.

- If WmInfoSize is **64**, the valid range is 1 to 18446744073709551615.

parameters.name: WmType
parameters.description:
The watermark type. Valid values:
- **PureWebappInvisible**: web watermark.
- **PureAppInvisible**: App watermark.
- **PureScreenInvisible**: screen watermark.
- **AigcWebappInvisible**: AIGC web watermark.
- **AigcAppInvisible**: AIGC App watermark.
- **AigcScreenInvisible**: AIGC screen watermark.
